description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling locale creation and retrieval based on language, merchant store, and HTTP request context.

classes.name: LocaleUtils
classes.description: Utility class for creating and retrieving Locale and Language objects based on different parameters such as Language, MerchantStore, and HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object based on a given Language object.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object for currency formatting based on MerchantStore's currency code, ignoring language.

methods.name: getRequestLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the Language object from the HTTP request session, defaulting to the store’s default language if not present.
